newsitem.title: CHILE: Escondida copper output up sharply in March.
newsitem.headline: Escondida copper output up sharply in March.

text.p: Escondida mine produced 76,918 tonnes of copper in March, up from 59,397 tonnes in the same month last year, Minera Escondida Ltda reported.
The new figures had been embargoed for 1500 local/2000 GMT Thursday. Because the embargo was broken by another news agency, Reuters is releasing the information now.
The March increase brought production in the first quarter to 209,121 tonnes, up from 175,641 tonnes in first quarter 1996, according to Escondida.
The March figure was comprised of 72,247 tonnes of copper in concentrates and 4,671 tonnes in cathodes, said Escondida.
The mine is owned by Broken Hill Proprietary and RTZ Corp plc.
